parameters.content:
## START HERE: Jobber Morning Ops Triage Copilot (DRAFT v0.1.0)
A read-only weekday-morning digest for the OWNER only: (1) Unscheduled / Late / Action Required jobs, (2) Requires Invoicing jobs and past-due invoices, (3) high-value quotes still awaiting a response after your configured follow-up cutoff, ranked by dollar value for a human call.

**Do these in order:**
1. Import this file (done). It is imported inactive, and the Schedule node is switched off.
2. testMode is on and **source** defaults to test, which is fictional sample data. Click **Execute workflow** on Manual Test Run. The result is a [TEST] message.
3. Compare it with sample_morning_digest.md in the pack.
4. The CSV path is the recommended way to start: export your own Jobs, Invoices, and Quotes reports from Jobber, set source = csv, and re-run. Still [TEST].
5. The live GraphQL path comes last, and only after a live Jobber test (see the UNVERIFIED note).

Status: DRAFT. Workflow JSON and Code nodes checked locally with fictional data. NOT tested against a live Jobber, Gmail, or Slack account.

## Config fields
- **source**: test (built-in fictional sample, default) | csv (read exports from csvFolder) | jobber (live read-only GraphQL queries). Anything else falls back to test.
- **testMode**: ON by default. Messages are labeled [TEST]. source = test always forces it on.
- **delivery**: email | slack | both | none. Owner only.
- **ownerEmail / ownerSlackChannel**: YOUR address and a private channel. Never a customer. They come only from this Config node, never from an input row.
- **jobberGraphqlVersion**: paste-here placeholder for the X-JOBBER-GRAPHQL-VERSION header. Live path only.
- **csvFolder**: folder with your Jobs, Invoices, and Quotes CSV exports. File names do not matter. n8n only reads files inside its allowed folder.
- **asOfOverride**: ISO time to pretend it is a different moment (to run an older export). Blank = now.
- **pastDueMinDays** (1): an invoice is listed once it is this many days past its due date. Due today is not past due.
- **quoteStalledDays** (blank until configured) and **quoteMinValue** (1000): a quote awaiting a response is listed once it is this old and worth at least this much. Set them just past your own Jobber follow-up schedule. Starting points, not industry standards.

## Safety defaults
- Imported **inactive**; Schedule **disabled**.
- **testMode** ON; source = **test** (fictional sample).
- **Zero Jobber write-back**: the Jobber steps send GraphQL **queries** only. GraphQL travels over HTTP POST, so the method shows POST, but there is no mutation in this file and nothing is created, changed, or deleted in Jobber.
- **No customer messages**: no SMS, no Twilio, no customer email, no review request, no On-My-Way text, no quote or invoice reminder. The only sends are one email and one Slack post to the owner.
- The stalled-quote list is for a **human** call or personal note, not another automated blast.
- Never invents numbers. A metric that cannot be computed becomes a "Heads-up" line.

## Live path: Jobber GraphQL + OAuth 2.0 (read-only queries). UNVERIFIED against a live Jobber account.
Endpoint: https://api.getjobber.com/api/graphql with header X-JOBBER-GRAPHQL-VERSION and an n8n OAuth2 credential (authorization code) named PLACEHOLDER_JOBBER. Three queries: jobs (with visits), invoices, quotes. First page only (up to 50 per connection); a Heads-up appears when more exists.
Jobber documents the core object fields including quote sentAt. Root queries, connection and amount subfields, status enums, and the selected API version still require a live read-only test. The quote queue requires an actual send date and shop-specific cutoff. Whether a Core-tier account can authorize a Draft app is not confirmed. A Draft app is limited to 5 paying accounts until Jobber approves it.

## CSV export (recommended first step, works on every Jobber tier)
Export your Jobs, Invoices, and Quotes reports from Jobber as CSV, drop them in csvFolder, set source = csv, and set asOfOverride if the export is not from today. This path only READS files. Headers are matched loosely (case, punctuation, spaces/underscores/hyphens ignored). Any one of the three reports is enough; a missing one becomes a Heads-up. See the pack README for the full header list. source = test uses the same kind of fictional files, built in.

## Credentials (placeholders only)
PLACEHOLDER_JOBBER (OAuth2, live path only), PLACEHOLDER_GMAIL, PLACEHOLDER_SLACK. Attach your own. No secrets, client IDs, or tokens are stored in this file. Do not paste real ones into Config and then share the workflow.

## Hard stop before go-live
Do not turn testMode off or switch the Schedule on until: (1) a clean [TEST] run from the sample data, (2) a clean [TEST] run from YOUR csv export, spot-checked by hand against Jobber, (3) ownerEmail / ownerSlackChannel confirmed as owner-only, (4) an owner has signed off in writing. Even live, this workflow only reports to the owner. It will not contact customers or change Jobber.
